title: 鐵路橋軌相互作用分析~Rail–bridge interaction analysis
focus: 橋梁溫伸制動位移與鋼軌約束~Bridge thermal movement braking displacement and rail restraint
summary: 鐵路橋軌相互作用分析以「橋梁溫伸制動位移與鋼軌約束」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。橋梁與連續鋼軌透過扣件和支承交換縱向作用，橋梁溫度、制動以及支承布置會改變鋼軌附加力，不能把橋與軌各自分析後忽略相容。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops bridge thermal movement braking displacement and rail restraint through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Bridges and continuous rails exchange longitudinal action through fastenings and supports; temperature, braking and bearing layout alter rail force, so separate analyses cannot omit compatibility. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把鐵路橋軌相互作用分析放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。橋梁與連續鋼軌透過扣件和支承交換縱向作用，橋梁溫度、制動以及支承布置會改變鋼軌附加力，不能把橋與軌各自分析後忽略相容。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Rail–bridge interaction analysis in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Bridges and continuous rails exchange longitudinal action through fastenings and supports; temperature, braking and bearing layout alter rail force, so separate analyses cannot omit compatibility. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=26.4 mm。模型邊界：均溫自由伸縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：bridge=20 mm, rail=5 mm；y=bridge-rail=15 mm。只把 bridge 增加百分之十，y=17 mm。模型邊界：同方向共同基準；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 mm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature free expansion; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: bridge=20 mm, rail=5 mm; y=bridge-rail=15 mm. Increasing only bridge with a ten-percent increase gives y=17 mm. Boundary: Shared datum and direction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 橋梁自由熱伸長~Bridge free thermal movement
units.title: 橋梁自由熱伸長~Bridge free thermal movement
units.mechanism: 自由端位移受有效伸縮長度而非總橋長控制。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均溫自由伸縮。使用固定支承位置與端部位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；固定點判錯會錯估位移方向，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Free-end movement depends on effective expansion length rather than total bridge length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.4 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform-temperature free expansion. Use fixed-bearing location and endpoint movement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=26.4 mm。模型邊界：均溫自由伸縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=80 m, dT=25 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=24 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.4 mm. Boundary: Uniform-temperature free expansion; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以固定支承位置與端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用梁溫計與端部位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「橋梁自由熱伸長」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use fixed-bearing location and endpoint movement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using girder thermometers and endpoint gauges, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Bridge free thermal movement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 固定點判錯會錯估位移方向。這個失效與「橋梁自由熱伸長」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查固定支承位置與端部位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction. This failure and a measurement bias in Bridge free thermal movement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check fixed-bearing location and endpoint movement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：固定點判錯會錯估位移方向~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction.
units.practice: 重算「橋梁自由熱伸長」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均溫自由伸縮如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由固定點判錯會錯估位移方向造成偏離的合成觀察，以固定支承位置與端部位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Bridge free thermal movement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform-temperature free expansion. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: An incorrect fixed point misidentifies movement direction. Explain which evidence in fixed-bearing location and endpoint movement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 橋軌相對位移~Relative rail-bridge movement
units.title: 橋軌相對位移~Relative rail-bridge movement
units.mechanism: 扣件受的是橋軌相對位移而非橋梁絕對位移。本模型把 bridge 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 17 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同方向共同基準。使用同位置橋軌雙位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；量測基準不同會產生假相對位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Fastenings respond to relative bridge-rail movement rather than absolute bridge displacement. In this model, bridge is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 17 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Shared datum and direction. Use paired bridge and rail movement at one location as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different datums create false relative movement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：bridge=20 mm, rail=5 mm；y=bridge-rail=15 mm。只把 bridge 增加百分之十，y=17 mm。模型邊界：同方向共同基準；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: bridge=20 mm, rail=5 mm; y=bridge-rail=15 mm. Increasing only bridge with a ten-percent increase gives y=17 mm. Boundary: Shared datum and direction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以同位置橋軌雙位移區分模型與觀察，先用雙通道位移計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「橋軌相對位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use paired bridge and rail movement at one location to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using two-channel displacement gauge, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Relative rail-bridge movement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 量測基準不同會產生假相對位移。這個失效與「橋軌相對位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同位置橋軌雙位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Different datums create false relative movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Relative rail-bridge movement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check paired bridge and rail movement at one location rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：量測基準不同會產生假相對位移~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different datums create false relative movement.
units.practice: 重算「橋軌相對位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出同方向共同基準如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由量測基準不同會產生假相對位移造成偏離的合成觀察，以同位置橋軌雙位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Relative rail-bridge movement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Shared datum and direction. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Different datums create false relative movement. Explain which evidence in paired bridge and rail movement at one location distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 縱向彈性分力~Longitudinal elastic force
units.title: 縱向彈性分力~Longitudinal elastic force
units.mechanism: 線性區相對位移經扣件剛度轉成縱向力。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 49.5 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單扣件預滑移區。使用相對位移與扣件力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；滑移後不能延用線性剛度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Within the linear range, relative movement becomes force through fastening stiffness. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 49.5 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One fastening before slip. Use relative movement and fastening force as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Linear stiffness cannot be extended beyond slip; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=15 kN/mm, d=3 mm；y=k*d=45 kN。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=49.5 kN。模型邊界：單扣件預滑移區；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=15 kN/mm, d=3 mm; y=k*d=45 kN. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=49.5 kN. Boundary: One fastening before slip; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以相對位移與扣件力區分模型與觀察，先用低載扣件模型建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「縱向彈性分力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use relative movement and fastening force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using low-load fastening model, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Longitudinal elastic force. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 滑移後不能延用線性剛度。這個失效與「縱向彈性分力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查相對位移與扣件力，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Linear stiffness cannot be extended beyond slip. This failure and a measurement bias in Longitudinal elastic force can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check relative movement and fastening force rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：滑移後不能延用線性剛度~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Linear stiffness cannot be extended beyond slip.
units.practice: 重算「縱向彈性分力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單扣件預滑移區如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由滑移後不能延用線性剛度造成偏離的合成觀察，以相對位移與扣件力說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Longitudinal elastic force, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One fastening before slip. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Linear stiffness cannot be extended beyond slip. Explain which evidence in relative movement and fastening force distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 制動平均分布~Mean braking distribution
units.title: 制動平均分布~Mean braking distribution
units.mechanism: 總制動力均布是簡化假設，真實載入跟列車位置移動。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 4.4 kN/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已知有效受力長度。使用列車位置與縱向載入作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；均布假設可能漏掉局部峰值，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Uniform total braking force is a simplification; actual loading moves with train position. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 4.4 kN/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Known effective loaded length. Use train position and longitudinal loading as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Uniform loading can miss local peaks; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=800 kN, L=200 m；y=F/L=4 kN/m。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=4.4 kN/m。模型邊界：已知有效受力長度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=800 kN, L=200 m; y=F/L=4 kN/m. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=4.4 kN/m. Boundary: Known effective loaded length; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以列車位置與縱向載入區分模型與觀察，先用合成列車位置與力建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「制動平均分布」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use train position and longitudinal loading to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.anchor: 支承縱向位移~Longitudinal bearing displacement
units.title: 支承縱向位移~Longitudinal bearing displacement
units.mechanism: 支承柔度把縱向作用轉為橋梁移動。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.3 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一線性支承。使用支承力位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承卡死會重新分配橋軌作用，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Bearing flexibility converts longitudinal action into bridge movement. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.3 mm. units.verify: 本單元以各支承反力與共同位移區分模型與觀察，先用雙荷重元與位移基準建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「相容反力分配」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use support reactions and common displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using paired load cells and displacement datum, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Compatible reaction sharing. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力。這個失效與「相容反力分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各支承反力與共同位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Changing one support alters force in the other. This failure and a measurement bias in Compatible reaction sharing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check support reactions and common displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Changing one support alters force in the other.
units.practice: 重算「相容反力分配」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩個平行線性支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由單一支承剛度變化會改變其他支承力造成偏離的合成觀察，以各支承反力與共同位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Compatible reaction sharing, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Two parallel linear supports. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Changing one support alters force in the other. Explain which evidence in support reactions and common displacement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
